simple.summary: מִשְׁחָר (mishchâr) means dawn First listed occurrence: Ps 110 3.

definitions.full: H4891. mishchar מִשְׁחָר noun [masculine] dawn ; — מ ׳מֵרֶחֶם Psa 110:3 , but מ probably dittograph, read שַׁחַר (Du, compare Buhl).
definitions.rootNote: from 7836 in the sense of day breaking ;
